changelog: Fixes AI features silently falling back during the first minutes after a restart: the discovery cycle used to fire every viewer's LLM and embedding calls back-to-back, which could exceed a provider's rate limit and make every call fail with no retry. LLM (Groq, OpenAI, etc.) and embedding (Voyage, Jina, OpenAI) calls now recognize a rate-limit response and retry once after the wait the provider asks for, capped to 10 seconds - a brief burst now recovers instead of degrading the whole cycle to local-only ranking.
